points: Pulsating Wand — shots that swell and shrink, fast, and bleed whatever they touch. Swampy Sigil — become a swamp monster with Berserk and dexterity, healed as you cast.

notes.title: Twilight of the Mad God
notes.subtitle: Season 31, Part 1 — Halloween
notes.lede: The Time Chamber closes and the Nexus dresses for Halloween. Memories — short, lore-driven solo dungeons — bring the first Heirlooms; two Druid sets and a basket of SweetTreats join them, and event Shinies finally reach regular characters. The Blood Ritual, the Infested Castle, Totalia and the Zombie Hordes return for four weeks.

Stoneborn Memory Portal.inside: The Red and the Purple Stone Guardian, taking turns. Each one beaten throws its blade into the arena, a hazard for the rest of the fight.
Stoneborn Memory Portal.loot: A blueprint toward the Stoneborn Husk, guaranteed

Infected Memory Portal.inside: The Founder, in a guild hall that is no longer yours, leading an infected horde against the Nexus's old heroes.
Infected Memory Portal.loot: A blueprint toward the Teratoma, guaranteed

added.description: A mischievous spirit haunting an ancient grave bell, ringing out an eerie chime wherever it goes.\n\nUnlocks the Grave Bell Poltergeist Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A mysterious key with a taste for secrets and souls.\n\nUnlocks the Hollow Key Keeper Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!
A living mass of teeth and eyes that seeks to prolong its user's suffering.
A decayed charm relighting only a fraction of a primal beast’s flame.
There were dark things in that water, even before the Wetlands' corruption. Only a druid could harness such power without being corrupted themself.
A three-dimensional slice of a fourth-dimensional object, fashioned into a sigil.
This relic was once used by a secluded cult of dragon worshippers. A druid may tap into its arcane power to embrace the form of a dragon.
An empty vessel.
Sheets of megaflora adorn a reptilian hide, shedding primeval lifeblood into its wearer.
An old leather armor overtaken by moss. The overgrowth seems to have made the armor self-healing.
A lesser sprite that has taken the form of an armor in hopes of adventure. The pain it feels is nothing compared to the glory it seeks.
A beautiful set of ornate ceremonial robes, filled with the energy of benevolent spirits from long ago.
A festival coat woven from thin, spiritual threads. It allows the user to skirt the spirit realm in search of their destination.
A worn plate from the Sage's armor. Its outwardly poor condition belies a strange, revitalizing effect still flowing within.
She refused to leave after the corruption took its toll on the village. It was her home after all.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
She was neither a sprite nor a cube. She was something entirely new.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

Once a farmer in their past life, they now rise again, lingering within the fallen leaves. During a full moon, a hunger grows inside of them; instead of harvesting crops, they harvest souls.\n\nSkin Class: Huntress
A lantern-bearing jester who lurks and snickers in the shadows, waiting to turn a little mischief into mayhem.\n\nSkin Class: Trickster
A masked marksman who turns the battlefield into a deadly dance—a sight to behold. Any unfortunate foes caught in the crossfire had better watch out.\n\nSkin Class: Archer

Queen Tiramisu is very fond of Bing Cat, Miss Cancan, and her beloved Realmers. She hears the kingdom’s complaints and will gladly go punch the royal council on your behalf. She is a little temperamental, so behave, or she'll punch you too.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
A sweet reward for those who always come back for another helping.
A fossilized footprint that still carries the strength of an ancient predator.
A humble sapling left untouched by the curse that pervades the Wetlands. Perhaps there is hope after all.
Infinite loops of infinite squares.

Every year, this dagger was awarded to the winner of a contest held during the kingdom's sweetest celebration.
Long ago, a skilled baker offered this bow to the hero who saved his village. It has changed hands many times since.
